ai_summary: The program provides employment services to veterans experiencing or at risk of homelessness to help them achieve stable employment. Eligible applicants include State and Local Workforce Development Boards, Native American Tribally-Designated Organizations, and faith-based organizations, with a requirement to maintain a physical location in the service area.
ai_quote: "HVRP is an employment-focused, competitive federal grant program intended to enable veterans experiencing or at risk of homelessness to reach their full employment potential"
